title: Container Forensic Fact Recoverability: protocol, analysis code and output sets
description: Protocol, harness, blinded scoring and analysis code for a preregistered randomized complete-block experiment on the recovery of independently verified pod creation, command execution and deletion from retained Kubernetes API server audit and Tetragon (eBPF) records after pod deletion, with a robustness series at doubled retained capacity and a flooding series. Includes the machine-readable fact contract (protocol/contract.yaml), the retention headroom and loss probability functions (src/frx/headroom.py) and the regeneration script (reproduce.sh). Analysis output sets are attached to the GitHub releases v1.0.1-submission, v1.1-robustness and v1.2-flooding.
